text: Many of you ask me the same question. Who are you, and why does a monk from the mountains speak English this way? So let me tell you my story. I was born high in the Himalayas, in a village with more prayer flags than people.

The monastery took me in when I was nine, and the monks sent me to an English mission school in the valley. That is where my voice learned its shape. My heart never left the mountain. As a young man I wanted the world. I travelled.

I chased noise, success, approval. And the more I gathered, the emptier I became. At thirty I came back, and for forty years I learned one thing in silence. Peace is not found by changing where you live.

It is found by changing how you meet your own mind. You can stand in the most beautiful place on earth, and if your thoughts are dark, that is where you truly live. And when the mind grows quiet, even a small life becomes rich.
I do not teach to escape the world. I teach so you can live in it gently. If you want to walk this path with me, Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
